name: Thiagarajar College of Engineering (TCE)
summary: Thiagarajar College of Engineering, Madurai, was established in 1957 by Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar. It is a government-aided college affiliated to Anna University, autonomous since 1987, accredited A++ (CGPA 3.56, cycle 2) by NAAC, with NBA-accredited programmes since 1998. Besides B.E./B.Tech it offers B.Arch and B.Des.
